name: 75228 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75228 (Dallas) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75228 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75228 (Dallas) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
